triggering_observation.full_catalog_effect: The complete ontology reduced 4B required-action recall to 0.594 and 0.688 and raised median latency to 4.35s and 4.07s.
triggering_observation.diagnosis: All 15 call definitions were supplied even when only one or two calls were proposed. Irrelevant alternatives increased context and decision interference.

single_changed_variable: Filter the same frozen ontology to definitions for only the calls already proposed in the current item.
cognitive_rationale: This is a relevance-limited working-memory operation: preserve information needed for the current judgment and omit unrelated action definitions.
fixed_variables: V35.1 system prompt and output shape
retired V34 cases and raw proposals
parser, validator, metrics, thresholds, and selection rule
prohibited_changes: No failed phrase or synonym may be added.
No ontology definition may be rewritten.
No metric threshold may be lowered.
No missing or rejected action may be invented.
stop_rule: If no candidate passes, stop the per-proposed-call semantic-authorizer line and redesign the action representation instead of adding more prompt patches.
